reasons: No check that project ids in the skill map exist
Skill names are repeated across lists and can drift apart
No tests are visible for this file

terms.meaning: a lookup table where each key points to a value, here a skill name pointing to project ids

sections.name: Skill
sections.title: Shape of a certificate entry
sections.what: Describes one certificate or course: its title, issuer, year, short tag, and an optional link to the credential.
sections.why: Keeps every certificate in the same format.
sections.watch_out: A missing year or issuer is stored as empty text, so display code must treat empty as unknown.

sections.name: SkillSection
sections.title: Shape of a certificate group
sections.what: Describes a labelled group of certificates, such as AI and Machine Learning.
sections.why: Lets the page show certificates in sections.

sections.name: skillSections
sections.title: Certificates grouped by area
sections.what: Lists the certificates in three groups: AI and Machine Learning, Strategy and Consulting, and Technology and Engineering.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely the source for the full skills page.
sections.watch_out: Some entries have empty issuers or years, so the page must handle blanks rather than show gaps.

sections.name: technicalSkills
sections.title: Full list of technical skills
sections.what: A single list of about nineteen technical skills, from Python to financial modeling.
sections.why: Likely reason: a complete list for display. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: These names are the keys the skill map relies on, so renaming one breaks its project links.

sections.name: skillGroups
sections.title: Shorter skill list for the home page
sections.what: Groups a shorter set of technical skills into three labelled groups for the compact module on the home page.
sections.why: The code comment says it is for the compact home module.
sections.watch_out: Skill names are typed again here instead of taken from the full list, so the two lists can drift apart.

sections.name: skillToBuildMap
sections.title: Link each skill to related projects
sections.what: For each technical skill, lists the project ids where it was used. This is how a skill can point to the projects that show it.
sections.why: The code comment says it maps skills to related build ids. Its exact display use is not stated.
sections.watch_out: Project ids are typed by hand. A misspelled id is not reported and the link simply goes nowhere.

sections.name: domainSkills
sections.title: Business and domain skills list
sections.what: A plain list of professional areas such as financial modeling, market research and fundraising, written as display text.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: These entries are not linked to the skill map, so they show no project links.

summary: Holds the owner's certificates, technical skills, business skills, and a map that links each technical skill to the projects where it was used.
purpose: Stores skill and certificate content so the skills and home pages can display it and link skills to projects.
why: Likely reason: lets the owner update skills without changing page layout. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Shapes for a certificate and a group come first. Then the certificate groups, the flat technical list, the shorter home-page groups, the skill-to-project map, and the business skill list.
inputs: Nothing is read from outside. Entries are typed into this file.
outputs: Exported lists and a map used by the skills and home pages.
risks: Project ids in the skill map are typed by hand. A misspelled id produces a link to nothing and no error is shown.
debug: If a skill link goes nowhere, check the id in skillToBuildMap against the project ids in projects.ts. If a skill is missing on the home page, check skillGroups.
